summary: Redact `sid` and `synotoken` recursively instead of only at the top level of a response object.
reason: Both session credentials arrive inside the DSM envelope, one level below the root. The generated redaction sweep only inspected top-level keys, so `session login --agent` printed the live session id and the anti-CSRF token in cleartext.
validated_outcome: `session_redact_test.go` covers both the flat object and the enveloped `{"data":{...},"success":true}` shape; `session login --agent` prints `***` for both keys.
